title: How To Win The Champions League

1.name: Real Madrid
1.ov: When it comes to lifting Europe’s most coveted football trophy, what are the secrets of success? This documentary tells the story of how Real Madrid became 'kings of Europe'.

1.name: Liverpool 2019
1.ov: How Jurgen Klopp galvanised a team – and the red half of the city – to deliver a sixth European title.

1.name: Jose Mourinho
1.ov: Fascinating, first-hand insights from one of the most iconic managers in football history as he reflects on how he twice won the biggest prize in European club football.
